2105-4885-7431-8330.easyPrerequisites: Combat Celebrant hasn't been exerted this turn.
2105-4885-7431-8330.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2105-4885-7431-8330.description:
Cast Massimo by paying its mana cost plus commander tax if applicable.
When Massimo enters, it triggers, exiling Daydream from your graveyard and giving Massimo the listed ability.
Declare Massimo and Combat Celebrant as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks.
Combat Celebrant triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage with Massimo. Its ability triggers, casting a copy of Daydream from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Daydream, blinking Combat Celebrant.
Repeat from step 3 each combat phase.

728-5170-6132-8292.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Massacre Girl triggers, dealing 1 damage to target opponent and causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Grimgrin ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Grimgrin and untapping it
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Massacre Girl trigger.
Resolve the Massacre Girl trigger, dealing 1 damage to target opponent and causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Grimgrin and untapping it
Repeat.

2645-2872-3430-5233.easyPrerequisites: Clever Conjurer doesn't have summoning sickness.
2645-2872-3430-5233.description:
Activate Boros Garrison by tapping it, adding {R}{R}{R}{W}{W}{W} due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate Clever Conjurer by tapping it, untapping Boros Garrison
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Clever Conjurer.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

339-677-3499-6495.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

1329-1778-2178-8095.notablePrerequisites: Emry does not have summoning sickness.
1329-1778-2178-8095.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Memnite from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Memnite from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Memnite.
When Memnite dies, Emry triggers, untapping Emry.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

2411-3259-3480.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2411-3259-3480.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Lathril, triggering Breath of Fury and Lathril.
Resolve the Lathril trigger, creating at least one creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

4050-5359-6972.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Threefold Thunderhulk.
When Threefold Thunderhulk dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
When Threefold Thunderhulk enters, it triggers, creating a number of 1/1 Golem artifact creature tokens equal to its power.
Repeat.

1251-1368-6006-6321.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
1251-1368-6006-6321.description:
Cast Malevolent Rumble for its escape cost by paying {1}{G} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing you to mill at least three cards and create a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

731-1880--147.notablePrerequisites:
Hallar has a number of +1/+1 counters on it equal to or greater than 9 minus the smallest number of poison counters an opponent has.
You have enough mana to cast the spell with kicker or multikicker, and there are legal target(s) for that spell, if applicable.
731-1880--147.description:
Cast the spell with kicker or multikicker by paying its mana cost plus its kicker cost at least once.
Hallar triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it, then causing each opponent to get a number of poison counters equal to its power.
Each opponent loses the game.
731-1880--147.notes: Hallar's power can be lower if you happen to have multiple kicker and/or multikicker spells that you can cast.

2034-4986-5463--44.description:
Cast an artifact in your hand by paying {0}.
Teshar triggers, returning Nurturing Pixie from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Nurturing Pixie enters, it triggers, returning another artifact that can be cast for {0} from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the artifact spell cast in step 1.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Nurturing Pixie
Repeat.
2034-4986-5463--44.notes: One of the {0} cost artifacts must be in your hand with the other on the battlefield.

339-677-2034-7175.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

5670-6705-6752.easyPrerequisites:
Your life total is at least 2.
You control at least one additional creature.
5670-6705-6752.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature, creating a Treasure token and a creature token.
When the creature token and Treasure token enter the battlefield, Haliya triggers twice, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat.

uses.n: The Legend of Kuruk // Avatar Kuruk

5902-7009-7068.manaNeeded: {3}{U} plus {20} minus {1} for each creature and artifact you control each turn available
5902-7009-7068.description:
Activate Avatar Kuruk by paying {20} minus {1} for each creature and/or artifact you can tap while activating it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Baboon Spirit triggers, blinking Avatar Kuruk and causing it to return to the battlefield as The Legend of Kuruk with two lore counters on it due to Innkeeper's Talent.
The Legend of Kuruk's first and second chapter abilities trigger, causing you to scry 2, draw a card, scry 2 and draw another card.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your precombat main phase. The Legend of Kuruk triggers, putting two lore counters on it. Its third chapter ability triggers, causing you to exile it and return it to the battlefield as Avatar Kuruk.
Repeat.

1017-2146-3532-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Wizard Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

3967-4375-5361.description:
Cast Technomancer by paying {5}{B}{B}.
When Technomancer enters, it triggers, causing you to mill three cards and return Auton Soldier from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Technomancer.
When Auton Soldier enters, it triggers. Holding priority, activate Yahenni by sacrificing Auton Soldier.
Resolve the Auton Soldier trigger, causing you to mill three cards and return Auton Soldier from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Technomancer.
Repeat from step 3.

1874-4017-5641.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1874-4017-5641.description:
Gain life.
Basking Broodscale triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Ajani's Welcome triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

292-4565-4968.description:
Activate Deathbringer Thoctar by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to itself.
Rite of Passage triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Deathbringer Thoctar.
Repeat an arbitrarily large number of times.
Move to the next turn, removing all damage marked on Deathbringer Thoctar.
Activate Deathbringer Thoctar by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat step 5 as desired.
292-4565-4968.notes: You can remove counters to deal damage to creatures you control, putting infinite +1/+1 counters on them due to Rite of Passage.

1363-1636-4031.easyPrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature,
1363-1636-4031.notablePrerequisites: There are at least three creatures in your party.
1363-1636-4031.description:
Cast Ardent Electromancer by paying {2}{R}.
When Ardent Electromancer enters the battlefield, it and Intruder Alarm trigger.
Resolve the Ardent Electromancer trigger, adding at least {R}{R}{R}.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Activate Tradewind Rider by tapping it, Ardent Electromancer and one other creature you control, returning Ardent Electromancer from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
1363-1636-4031.notes: If you control creature(s) that can tap to produce mana, you can use that mana to pay for the creature and instead gain mana from the creature's ETB ability.

5231-6303-6520.easyPrerequisites: You have two or more opponents.
5231-6303-6520.notablePrerequisites: You control two creatures that do not have summoning sickness.
5231-6303-6520.description:
Declare two creatures you control as attackers, attacking two different opponents.
Holding priority, activate Nemesis Phoenix by paying {R}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped and attacking.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Nemesis Phoenix, adding {R}.
Repeat from step 2.

1879-2105-3204-4251.notablePrerequisites:
Mysterious Limousine does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
One of Godo or Combat Celebrant must be on the battlefield, with the other exiled by Mysterious Limousine.
1879-2105-3204-4251.description:
Declare either Godo or Combat Celebrant and Mysterious Limousine as attackers.
Mysterious Limousine and either Godo or Combat Celebrant trigger.
Resolve the Godo or Combat Celebrant trigger, untapping Mysterious Limousine and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Mysterious Limousine trigger, exiling Godo or Combat Celebrant from the battlefield, and then returning Godo or Combat Celebrant from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

1879-2457-2557-4289.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate two Insects by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat.

957-1987-4423-4823.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four Islands.
957-1987-4423-4823.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Time Stretch by paying its mana cost, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Move to your first extra turn.
Activate Mystic Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Timeless Witness.
When Timeless Witness and Mystic Sanctuary enter the battlefield, they trigger.
Resolve the Timeless Witness trigger, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mystic Sanctuary trigger, putting Time Stretch from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Move to your next turn, drawing Time Stretch during your draw step.
Repeat.

2208-4499-4605-5542.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Charming Scoundrel.
When Charming Scoundrel enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, and Preston triggers twice if it has power 2 or less, or once otherwise.
Resolve the Charming Scoundrel triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve the first Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Charming Scoundrel that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Charming Scoundrel token enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Repeat from step 4 for the remaining Preston trigger, if applicable.
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}.
Repeat.
2208-4499-4605-5542.notes: You may instead create Wicked Role tokens and/or rummage using Charming Scoundrel's triggers if you have mana available. If you attach the Wicked Roles to Charming Scoundrel, they will fall off when it is blinked, causing opponents to lose life.

2-2440.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three Golems.
2-2440.description:
Cast Ancestral Statue by paying {4}.
When Ancestral Statue enters the battlefield, it and Mana Echoes trigger.
Resolve the Mana Echoes trigger, adding {C} for each Golem you control.
Resolve the Ancestral Statue trigger, returning it to your hand from the battlefield.
Repeat.
If you control at least four Golems to start the combo, this combo nets infinite colorless mana.

1303-3362.description:
Cast Bladewing by paying {3}{B}{B}{R}{R}.
Bladewing enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Necroduality.
Resolve the Bladewing trigger, returning any Dragon from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Necroduality trigger, creating a token copy of Bladewing.
Put the nontoken Bladewing from the battlefield into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The token Bladewing enters the battlefield, returning the nontoken Bladewing from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Put the nontoken Bladewing from the battlefield into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Bladewing's enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 7.

uses.n: Budoka Gardener // Dokai, Weaver of Life

224-1993-4300.notablePrerequisites:
You control nine or fewer lands.
You have a land card in hand that enters the battlefield untapped and can tap to produce at least {1}.
224-1993-4300.description:
Activate Budoka Gardener by tapping it, putting the land from your hand onto the battlefield.
When the land enters the battlefield, Retreat to Coralhelm triggers, untapping Budoka Gardener.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Meloku by paying {1} and returning the land from the battlefield to your hand, creating a 1/1 Illusion creature token.
Repeat.

1228-3523.notablePrerequisites:
Gorgon's Head attached to Goblin Sharpshooter.
Goblin Sharpshooter does not have summoning sickness.
1228-3523.description:
Activate Goblin Sharpshooter by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to target creature.
That creature dies from lethal damage due to Goblin Sharpshooter's deathtouch ability.
Goblin Sharpshooter triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat for each creature opponents control and whenever an opponent controls a creature.
